chunks: The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Dyeing is the way of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, and it is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition)."

key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: The prophetic tradition and normative practice
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ: The Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Is dyeing the hair or beard considered part of the sunnah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام states that applying dye is part of the practice and guidance of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. The hadith presents it as an aspect of the sunnah and a form of personal beautification and cleanliness.
